title: Design System: Chu Dịch Linh Quái

display.purpose: Quiet reading headings; self-hosted Latin and Vietnamese subsets.

body.purpose: Controls and prose; self-hosted 400 and 500 weights.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: Depth beneath the coin plate only.

motion.name: coin-flight
motion.purpose: Rise, flip, land, bounce and settle.

motion.name: line-commit
motion.purpose: Record the line after every coin settles.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No spinning or staggering when reduced motion is preferred.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column workspace and full-width reading note.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Reduced padding and narrow reading index.

rules: Moving lines use text markers as well as cinnabar color.
Keep translation availability and classical source notes visible.
Use native dialogs for focus containment and Escape dismissal.
